note: Machine-readable index of every ui-guard rule. checker: stylelint|eslint|script|ai|runtime|assets|none. inScan:false = never part of /ui-guard:scan (MEDIA-01..06 are checked by media-check.js in the scan; MEDIA-07/08 by /ui-guard:assets; MEDIA-09 is guidance; FIX-01..03 only in /ui-guard:check, against the linked work item). Domains: STYLE → /ui-guard:scan scss, ACCESS → access, LANG → lang, SAFE → safe; MEDIA and FIX belong to no domain. ucr = the matching ui-code-review rule ID (ui-guard applies the same rule text). axis = the AXIS rule IDs a STYLE rule implements (R-xx, R-<SEGMENT>-n; A11Y-CSS-n = AXIS guides/accessibility.md stylesheet rule n; PERF-BUDGET = guides/performance.md; R-SEG-STRUCTURE = the segment tree and fixed names of README.md); its severity follows the AXIS priority (Critical → error, High → warning, Medium → info). group: AI routing group or family. lintMap maps Stylelint/ESLint rule names to ui-guard IDs.

rules.title: Authored classes carry their segment/role or state prefix
js-* hook classes have no styles
Who sets a class decides its prefix (is-/has- static, js- runtime)
BEM block__element, one level, no --modifier
Nesting depth at most 4 (root = level 1; only @media is not counted)
Class selectors only outside generic/elements (no type, universal, :root outside the token files, :host)
No ID selectors
No attribute selectors ([aria-*] / :is([dir="rtl"]) only chained onto a project class)
Tokens named by role or family-step; no typos
Absolute lengths via px()/rem; raw px only for 1px
Logical properties only — width/height and min-/max- become inline-size/block-size
Colors only from custom properties
Every shade in token files is HSL
At most 4 decimals
Media queries only through mq() (the project ships it)
Settings and tools output no CSS
AXIS file names and folders; a file styles only its own block
Layout holds chrome only; pages hold own content only
Module purity; isolated ctrl- control modules
Objects are undecorated fixed patterns
No !important (only the one generic reduced-motion block)
No @extend except %placeholder
No duplicate selectors, properties or mq blocks
No empty blocks or comments
Utilities: u- prefix, one property, u-{property}-{value} with the short names, no breakpoint names
@charset "UTF-8"; is the first line
packages/ never compiled; vendor CSS before project styles
Import routes: shared via common/, page-local from each page entry; files never move; only a module @uses a component
No double import of files reached through common/
Component styles @use only settings/tools (a routed page also its page-local blocks); no @import
No ::ng-deep
Colour token files contain only :root blocks; fonts.theme.css only @font-face and :root
custom.theme.css: classes and body only, no custom properties
The palette is the single source of shade values; fluid tokens declared once
All themes define the same custom property names
Theme files load via <link> (base, palette, fonts); custom.theme.css last
Icons colored by u-filter-* utilities reading --filter-* tokens; no literal filters, no [data-img]
Tools: one file per tool, never duplicated, documented (signature, params with defaults, output, example)
One shared button component
No outline removal without :focus-visible replacement
:hover inside (hover: hover) with matching :focus-visible (fixable: @include hover)
One reduced-motion block in generic; u-sr-only declared once in utilities/accessibility/ and never re-implemented
Interactive targets at least 1.5rem
Token pairs meet WCAG AA contrast in every theme (4.5:1 text, 3:1 large text and control borders)
No horizontal overflow from 320px
CSS size budget (AXIS performance.md)
Block elements and variants are written inside the block (&__element, &-variant)
Architecture gap: the project has the AXIS structure (segments, tools, settings, theme, entries); a legacy stylesheet stays frozen
Generic and Elements style HTML elements only (no class, no ID)
Elements: base body background only (per-theme one only in custom.theme.css); base typography reads the font tokens
Every tool parameter is validated with @error
A tool takes its values as parameters; no hard-coded component/page/client value
Colour utilities are generated with @each over settings/_colors.settings.scss maps
Vendor overrides only in their library module, on its m- block; a plain module holds no vendor selector
Every settings map has a comment: what it holds and what reads it
